data.description: 穿衣镜前，换衣中途的唯套着敞怀的大码白衬衫。黑发白发箍衬托下，整张清丽面庞早已红透至耳根。双手无措地按在透肉黑丝大腿上，身子略微拘谨前倾，咬着下唇偏过头不敢正视你，结结巴巴斥责却全无平日风纪委员的威严。
data.promptProse: Leaning forward with both palms pressed shyly against her sheer-black-pantyhose-clad thighs before the mirror, Yui blushes deeply as her unbuttoned white dress shirt hangs open, averting her golden-brown eyes in bashful, flustered mortification.
